stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (Fall 2025 entering class): 16,560 applied, 3,683 admitted (22.2%), 857 enrolled; the residency rows (in-state 2,273 / out-of-state 10,183 / international 4,104) add up to the totals for applicants and for admits (495 + 2,908 + 280) and enrolled (108 + 677 + 72). International (nonresident) first-years: 4,104 applied, 280 admitted (6.8%), 72 enrolled. The ED counts (1,154 applications, 421 admitted) are printed under the label 'For the Fall 2024 entering class' in the 2025-26 CDS, but the 2024-25 CDS prints different Fall 2024 figures (1,175 / 397), so the label looks like a template carry-over; treat the ED counts as approximate and the year as unconfirmed. Richmond also has non-binding Early Action; the CDS gives no EA counts. Test-submitter shares are of enrolled first-years (SAT 159 students = 18.6%, ACT 124 = 14.5%); the CDS lists the SAT/ACT composite 25th/50th/75th percentiles as 1420/1440/1490 and 33/33/34. The GPA breakdown is the 'all enrolled students' column of C11 (rows with no value are left out); average GPA 3.81, all enrollees reported a GPA. Undergraduate enrollment (3,052) and the nonresident count (351) are the CDS 'Total Undergraduates' figures (B1/B2). Student-to-faculty ratio 7:1 (I-2, fall 2025).

cost.notes: First-year, full-time costs from the Common Data Set (G1/G5, 2026-27 academic year): tuition $70,725 (required fees are included in tuition), on-campus food and housing $18,815 (housing $8,705 + food $10,110), books and supplies $1,000, other expenses $1,780 (the aid office lists personal expenses $1,710 plus $70 Direct Loan fees). The sum, $92,320, equals the total cost of attendance on the financial aid office's cost page (opened 2026-11-03); that page lists 2025-26 as $67,840 tuition and $88,460 total. Aid to nonresidents (CDS H6): 187 undergraduate degree-seeking nonresidents received institutional aid, average $67,911, total $12,699,322; the financial aid office states the average award (need-based, merit, etc.) to international students in 2025-26 was $69,900.
